```
Use only information stated in the supplied text, including in brief descriptive modifiers and appositives. Familiarity with a subject does not license adding a category, property, setting or explanation. Remove any unsupported embellishment rather than relying on outside knowledge.

When the source presents a dispute, prioritize the main event, the participants' attributed positions and the source-supported basis of the disagreement over secondary chronology or procedural details. A criticism of a position does not by itself communicate who holds that position. Select complementary content rather than several passages serving the same role.

For exact extraction, preserve the context needed to identify a quotation's speaker and the referents of dependent sentences. Choose a feasible set of complete source sentences within the existing budget; if necessary, prefer a clearer self-contained alternative. Do not rewrite, combine or add attribution to extracted sentences.
```
